description:
[Game reference] Turrets and traps: damage, range, arc, ammo, power, HP, recipe, TC rules. Every player trap/turret plus the NPC safe-zone turrets: `hp`, `damage_text`, the raw damage fields, `sight_range`,
`arc_degrees`, `range`, `power` (electricity), ammo/fuel, `craft` recipe, `needs_privilege_to_use`, `notes` (targeting
and Tool Cupboard rules), `explosives` to destroy. key= for one defence (autoturret, flameturret, guntrap, trap-landmine, trap-bear, samsite, electric-teslacoil). Link https://rust.wiki/traps-and-turrets.
